description: Ordered build plan. One task = one PR. Respect depends_on. Each task lists acceptance criteria that must be ticked in the PR description. Phases go live at the pilot garage as soon as they pass their acceptance tests.

phases.name: Foundations
phases.goal: Staff can sign in to their garage on a secure, multi-tenant, beautifully themed shell.

tasks.title: Project scaffold and tooling
tasks.description: Create the Next.js (App Router, TypeScript strict) app with pnpm, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, Playwright, Sentry, Vercel Analytics. Add folder structure from project.config.json, .env.example with every env var, README setup steps, docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/CHANGELOG.md. GitHub Actions CI running lint, typecheck, unit tests and build.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm dev starts the app; pnpm build succeeds
CI passes on the PR
.env.example lists every variable in project.config.json
Vercel preview deploy works

tasks.title: Design system: tokens, fonts, core components
tasks.description: Implement design-tokens.json as CSS variables (light + dark 'workshop' themes) mapped into Tailwind. Load Bricolage Grotesque, Inter, JetBrains Mono via next/font. Theme shadcn components to Pit Stop Pop (pill buttons, 2px borders, chunky shadows). Build brand components: Button variants, Card, StatusPill, PlateChip, MoneyText, StatTile, Stepper, EmptyState, CarAvatar (SVG per body type, tinted), VehicleHealthCard, Confetti helper, theme toggle. Create a /design route (dev only) showcasing every component in both themes.
acceptance_criteria: No hardcoded hex colours outside the token files
/design page shows all components in light and dark
Contrast checks pass AA for text tokens
prefers-reduced-motion disables confetti and springs

tasks.title: Database, Drizzle and RLS foundation
tasks.description: Set up Supabase (local via CLI + staging project), Drizzle config, and migrations for: users, garages, garage_settings, branches, bays, memberships, document_sequences, audit_logs, webhook_events, plans, subscriptions, message_usage, magic_links, notifications, push_subscriptions. Write RLS helper SQL functions (current_user_id(), is_member(garage_id), member_role(garage_id), member_branch(garage_id)) and policies. Money helpers in lib/money with tests. UUID v7 helper.
acceptance_criteria: Migrations apply cleanly on an empty database
Integration test proves a member of garage A cannot read or write garage B rows
audit_logs rejects UPDATE and DELETE
lib/money unit tests cover formatting, rounding and parsing 'GH₵ 1,250.50'

tasks.title: Authentication and sessions
tasks.description: Supabase Auth for staff (email+password and phone OTP), customers (phone OTP) and vendors (email+password). Login, OTP verify, forgot password, sign-out. Middleware that resolves the session and, for /g/[garageSlug] routes, the active membership. Rate limit OTP requests. Phone normalisation to E.164 (+233).
acceptance_criteria: Staff can sign in with email/password and with phone OTP
Visiting /g/other-garage without membership returns 404
OTP limited to 5 requests per phone per hour
Local numbers like 0241234567 normalise to +233241234567

tasks.title: Permissions engine and audit logging
tasks.description: Implement can(principal, permission, context) from roles-permissions.json, including discount limits and field-level rules; garageHasFeature() from plans.json. A withAction() wrapper for Server Actions: Zod validation → membership → permission → plan feature → transaction → audit log → typed result. UI helpers <Can permission> and useCan().
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover every role against a sample of permissions
Server Action without permission returns { ok:false, error.code:'FORBIDDEN' }
Financial actions write audit_logs with before/after

tasks.title: Garage onboarding and staff invites
tasks.description: Sign-up flow creating user + garage + default branch + owner membership + trial subscription (Pro, complimentary flag for pilot). Onboarding wizard: garage details & logo, branches, bays, invite staff by phone/email with role and branch (invite link via SMS/WhatsApp/email using mock provider locally), labour rate and tax rules, finish. Staff management page (list, change role, suspend).
acceptance_criteria: New garage can complete onboarding in under 5 minutes
Invited mechanic accepts invite and lands on 'My jobs'
Owner can suspend a member and their session loses access immediately

tasks.title: App shell, navigation, command palette, notifications centre
tasks.description: Responsive shell: sidebar on desktop, bottom tab bar on mobile, role-aware nav from ui-screens.json, branch switcher, theme toggle, user menu. Command palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K) with search stubs. Notifications bell with realtime updates via Supabase Realtime. i18n with next-intl (en).
acceptance_criteria: Nav items match the role (mechanic sees only My jobs, Vehicles lookup, Stats)
Shell works at 360px width
New notification appears without refresh

tasks.title: Integration adapters, Inngest and messaging core
tasks.description: Inngest client and /api/inngest route. Adapter interfaces and mock implementations per integrations.json (MessagingProvider for sms/whatsapp/email/push, PaymentProvider, StorageProvider, InsuranceProvider, DvlaProvider). sendMessage Inngest function: render template, quiet hours, allowance check, provider call, message_log, retries, WhatsApp→SMS fallback. Webhook routes with signature verification and idempotency. Seed platform message_templates from message-templates.json. PWA manifest and service worker with push subscription.
acceptance_criteria: With providers set to 'mock', messages appear in a dev inbox page /dev/messages
Quiet-hours message is rescheduled to 07:00
Duplicate webhook event is ignored
Push notification received on an installed PWA in staging

tasks.title: Seed script
tasks.description: scripts/seed.ts that loads seed-data.json: platform admin, plans, demo garage with branches/bays/staff, customers, vehicles with odometer history, parts and stock, vendors and products, insurance partner, DVLA fee table. Idempotent.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm db:seed runs twice without duplicates
Logging in as each seeded role works

phases.name: Core workshop
phases.goal: The pilot garage stops using paper job cards.

tasks.title: Customers
tasks.description: Migrations for customers. List with search (name, phone), filters (type, tags), create/edit drawer, duplicate detection by phone, customer profile (vehicles, jobs, invoices, balance, documents, messages, preferences).
acceptance_criteria: Creating a customer with an existing phone offers to open the existing record
Search returns results in < 300ms on 10k seeded customers

tasks.title: Vehicles, ownership and odometer
tasks.description: Migrations for vehicles, vehicle_ownerships, odometer_readings, documents. Vehicle create (plate normalisation, make/model autocomplete), transfer ownership, document uploads, vehicle profile with VehicleHealthCard and timeline. Odometer recording with validation rules from reminder-rules.json and flagged-reading review. Command palette searches plates (ignoring spaces/hyphens) and phones.
acceptance_criteria: Lower odometer reading is flagged and excluded
Ownership transfer keeps history on the vehicle

tasks.title: Mileage prediction service
tasks.description: lib/domain/mileage.ts per reminder-rules.json mileage_prediction, including all test_cases. Inngest function on vehicle/odometer.recorded and nightly recalculation updating vehicles.km_per_day and confidence. Show estimate on vehicle profile.
acceptance_criteria: All mileage test_cases in reminder-rules.json pass
Vehicle profile shows km/day and confidence

tasks.title: Job templates
tasks.description: CRUD for job templates (default items, checklist, estimated time, deposit %, creates_due_item_type). Seed common templates: Oil service (mineral / semi / full synthetic), Full service, Brake pads, Diagnostics, Roadworthy pre-inspection, Tyre change, Battery replacement.
acceptance_criteria: Templates selectable during check-in and estimate building

tasks.title: Check-in wizard and job cards
tasks.description: Migrations for jobs, job_status_events, job_assignments, job_findings, job_media, job_tasks, time_logs. Tablet-friendly check-in wizard: find/create customer & vehicle, odometer (required) with photo, fuel level slider, complaint, walk-around photos, items left in car, template, assign mechanic & bay, promised time, customer signature pad. Job detail page with tabs (overview, findings, items, tasks, media, timeline). Enforce job_status_transitions and side effects from data-model.json.
acceptance_criteria: Check-in completes in under 2 minutes on a tablet
Invalid status transition is rejected server-side
Every status change writes job_status_events

tasks.title: Kanban job board (realtime)
tasks.description: Board by status columns with optional bay swimlanes; drag-and-drop updates status (validated), filters (mechanic, priority, branch), card shows plate chip, car avatar, customer, promised time countdown, assignees. Realtime sync across devices. Satisfying spring animations.
acceptance_criteria: Two browsers see a card move within 1 second
Dropping into a disallowed column snaps back with a friendly message

tasks.title: Mechanic mobile experience (offline-tolerant)
tasks.description: 'My jobs' for mechanics: today's assigned jobs, job detail with checklist, start/pause timer per task, add findings with photo/video/voice note, request parts, mark task done, move to quality_check. Offline queue (IndexedDB) for timer events, checklist ticks, notes and photos with client_id idempotency; sync indicator. 48px touch targets, dark workshop mode default.
acceptance_criteria: In airplane mode a mechanic can tick checklist items and start/stop timers; they sync when back online without duplicates
Photos upload with progress and retry

tasks.title: Estimates and customer approval
tasks.description: Migrations for job_items, estimates, approvals. Estimate builder: labour (hours × rate or flat), parts (from catalogue placeholder until P3, or free text), sundries, line discounts within permission limits, tax calculation (lib/domain/tax.ts), deposit required. Send via magic link (SMS/WhatsApp/email). Public approval page /t/[token]: branded, photos of findings, approve/decline per line, signature, pay deposit (Paystack, wired in P2 — show 'pay at garage' until then). Approve-on-behalf with reason. Versioning when re-sent.
acceptance_criteria: Customer approves 2 of 3 lines; job shows partial approval and totals update
Approve-on-behalf requires a reason and is audited
Tax unit tests cover compound and inclusive pricing

tasks.title: Quality check, ready and delivery
tasks.description: QC checklist sign-off by owner/manager, move to Ready (engine-rev animation), notify customer with pickup message. Delivery step (invoice gate stubbed until P2). Warranty/comeback linking to a previous job.
acceptance_criteria: Cannot reach Ready without QC sign-off
Comeback job links to parent and counts in mechanic stats

tasks.title: Customer live tracker
tasks.description: /t/[token] tracker page: Stepper with job progress, customer-visible notes and photos, mechanic first name, ETA, garage contact buttons (call, WhatsApp, directions). Realtime updates. Link sent at check-in.
acceptance_criteria: Tracker updates live when status changes
Internal notes and non-visible media never appear
Expired token shows a friendly expired page

tasks.title: Bookings and public booking page
tasks.description: Migrations for bookings. Staff calendar (day/week by bay), create/confirm/cancel bookings, convert booking to check-in. Public page /b/[garageSlug]: choose service, vehicle details, slot from capacity, phone OTP-lite (SMS code) to confirm. Confirmation + day-before reminder.
acceptance_criteria: Fully booked slots are not offered
Booking converts to a job with customer and vehicle pre-filled

phases.name: Money
phases.goal: Every payment goes through the app and the owner can see daily and monthly profit.

tasks.title: Invoices and PDFs
tasks.description: Migrations for invoices, invoice_lines, credit_notes. Draft invoice auto-created from approved job items at Ready; manual invoices. Issue (assigns gapless number, freezes totals). Void (owner, reason). Credit notes. PDF (A4 + 80mm thermal) via @react-pdf/renderer in an Inngest function; share via WhatsApp/SMS link/email; print. Invoice list with filters and status chips.
acceptance_criteria: Two invoices issued concurrently get consecutive numbers with no gaps or duplicates
Issued invoice cannot be edited
PDF matches garage branding

tasks.title: Payments: cash, MoMo, card, transfer; receipts
tasks.description: Migrations for payments, payment_allocations, refunds. Record cash/transfer/cheque payments. Paystack integration: MoMo charge (network selection, prompt on customer phone), card checkout; verify via webhook; idempotent. Receipt numbers and PDFs, sent automatically. Pay page /t/[token] for invoices. Deposits on estimates applied on invoice issue. Refunds with permission. Confetti on fully paid.
acceptance_criteria: MoMo test payment marks invoice paid via webhook only
Replay of the same webhook does not double-count
Receipt sent on every successful payment
Deposit paid on estimate appears as allocation on the invoice

tasks.title: Instalments (payment plans)
tasks.description: Migrations for payment_plans, instalments. Create plan from an invoice (down payment, count, frequency, start date, optional late fee). Schedule preview. Each instalment creates a due_item (type instalment). Pay individual instalments via link. Overdue handling and late fees. Plan status changes.
acceptance_criteria: Plan of 3 monthly instalments creates 3 due items with correct dates
Paying all instalments marks plan and invoice paid

tasks.title: Credit accounts
tasks.description: Migrations for credit_accounts, credit_statements. Open account (limit, terms), charge invoices to account (limit check), payments allocated across invoices, monthly statement generation (Inngest) with ageing buckets and PDF, statement due item. Account page with balance and ageing chart.
acceptance_criteria: Charging beyond the limit is blocked unless owner overrides (audited)
Ageing buckets are correct in unit tests
Statement generated on statement_day

tasks.title: Delivery gate
tasks.description: Job cannot move to Delivered unless the invoice is issued and paid, or charged to a credit account, or covered by an active payment plan. Delivery issues reserved stock (P3 hook) and creates due items from the job template.
acceptance_criteria: Unpaid job cannot be delivered
Delivering an oil service job creates an oil_change due item with date and mileage

tasks.title: Expenses and cash-up
tasks.description: Migrations for expense_categories (seeded), expenses, cash_ups. Expense entry with receipt photo. End-of-day cash-up: expected by method vs counted cash, difference, notes.
acceptance_criteria: Cash-up shows expected cash from the day's cash payments minus cash refunds

tasks.title: Reports: daily and monthly
tasks.description: Migrations for report_snapshots. Daily summary and monthly report per PRD 5.11 (sales by category, payments by method, expenses, COGS, gross & net profit, comparison), outstanding balances, staff performance. Snapshot Inngest jobs; live view for today. Charts (recharts, token colours). Export CSV and PDF.
acceptance_criteria: Monthly profit equals sum of daily profits for the month
Profit hidden from roles without permission
CSV export opens correctly in Excel

tasks.title: Owner dashboard
tasks.description: Dashboard per ui-screens.json: today's revenue, jobs by status, cars ready for pickup, payments due, low stock (after P3), reminders due this week, cash position, quick actions.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard loads in < 2.5s on mid-range Android 4G (Lighthouse throttled)

phases.name: Parts and vendors
phases.goal: Stock is tracked and parts are ordered from vendors in a few taps.

tasks.title: Parts catalogue and stock
tasks.description: Migrations for parts, stock_levels, stock_movements. Catalogue CRUD, CSV import with preview and error report, barcode field, photos. Stock per branch, adjustments with reason, transfers between branches, weighted average costing, low-stock list. Connect estimate builder to catalogue (reserve on approval, issue on delivery, return unused).
acceptance_criteria: CSV import of 500 parts succeeds with a validation report
Every stock change has a stock_movement
Approved job part reserves stock; delivery issues it

tasks.title: Point of sale (counter sales)
tasks.description: Migrations for pos_sales. Fast POS screen: search/scan, cart, optional customer, discount within limit, payment (cash/MoMo/card), receipt print/SMS/WhatsApp. Returns.
acceptance_criteria: Counter sale of 3 items completes in under 30 seconds
Return puts stock back and issues a credit note

tasks.title: Purchase orders and goods receiving
tasks.description: Migrations for purchase_orders, purchase_order_items, goods_receipts. Create PO (marketplace vendor or external supplier), approval, receive full/partial, update stock and average cost.
acceptance_criteria: Partial receipt leaves PO partially_delivered with correct remaining quantities

tasks.title: Vendor onboarding and dashboard
tasks.description: Migrations for vendors, vendor_members, vendor_products, vendor_reviews. Vendor sign-up, profile, delivery zones, payout details (Paystack subaccount), admin approval. Product catalogue CRUD + CSV import. Vendor dashboard: orders, fulfilment actions, sales, payouts, ratings.
acceptance_criteria: Pending vendor is invisible in the marketplace until approved
Vendor can import products by CSV

tasks.title: Marketplace ordering for garages
tasks.description: Migrations for vendor_orders, vendor_order_items, vendor_order_events. Browse/search products across approved vendors that deliver to the garage's region, compare price and ETA, cart grouped by vendor, checkout (Paystack split payment to vendor subaccount, commission_bp default 0), order tracking timeline, receive into stock (creates goods receipt), review vendor. Map vendor products to garage parts.
acceptance_criteria: Order flows placed → accepted → out_for_delivery → delivered → received and stock increases
Only vendors delivering to the garage's region appear
Review allowed only after received

tasks.title: Job-linked ordering and auto-reorder
tasks.description: When an approved part is out of stock, suggest vendor products and order linked to the job (job → waiting_parts; on receipt notify mechanic and move back to in_progress option). Nightly + on-movement Inngest check: parts below reorder_level with preferred vendor create a draft PO/vendor order; auto-send if garage enabled auto_reorder and total within spend limit, else notify for one-tap approval.
acceptance_criteria: Stock dropping below reorder level creates exactly one draft order
Auto-send respects the spend limit
Job-linked order receipt notifies the assigned mechanic

tasks.title: Customer ordering to garage and online parts catalogue
tasks.description: Customers (portal) browse vendor products filtered by their vehicle, choose a garage for delivery and fitting, pay, and the garage receives the incoming order and books a fitting job. Garage online catalogue: parts flagged online_visible orderable for pickup or fitting.
acceptance_criteria: Customer order appears in garage incoming orders and converts to a booking/job with the parts attached

phases.name: Reminders and renewals
phases.goal: Reminders go out automatically and the garage earns from renewals.

tasks.title: Due items and reminder engine
tasks.description: Migrations for due_items, reminder_messages, message_templates (garage overrides). Implement reminder-rules.json: escalation stages, effective_due_date, hourly scan, batching into combined messages, channel routing and fallback, quiet hours, allowance check, delivery status updates from webhooks, auto-completion rules. Reminders centre UI: upcoming, sent, failed, converted; manual send; edit templates with variable preview.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover escalation for every due_item_type
Two items due the same week produce one combined message
Failed WhatsApp falls back to SMS within 15 minutes
Over-allowance garage sends only push/email and owner is notified once

tasks.title: Oil change records and reminders
tasks.description: Oil service record fields on delivery (oil grade, brand, quantity, filters) using interval defaults, due item creation with due_date and due_mileage_km, prediction-driven effective date, mileage confirm and nudge templates, manual 'last oil change' entry for new customers.
acceptance_criteria: Reminder fires on predicted mileage date when it comes before the date interval
Low-confidence vehicle receives mileage_confirm first

tasks.title: Reminder action pages
tasks.description: /t/[token] pages for book_now, update_mileage, already_done, renew_with_garage, pay_now with conversion tracking and pause rules.
acceptance_criteria: Booking from a reminder sets converted_booking_id and pauses that due item
Mileage update recalculates prediction immediately

tasks.title: Insurance policies and reminders
tasks.description: Migrations for insurance_partners, insurance_policies. Policy CRUD on vehicle profile with document upload; due item created from end_date; health card ring.
acceptance_criteria: Saving a policy expiring in 20 days schedules the 14-day reminder next

tasks.title: DVLA records, fee table and reminders
tasks.description: Migrations for dvla_records, dvla_fees. Records CRUD (roadworthy, registration/licence, driver's licence) with documents; admin fee table; due items; pre-inspection booking action.
acceptance_criteria: Roadworthy expiring creates reminders and a 'book pre-inspection' action

tasks.title: Agent renewal workflow (insurance + DVLA)
tasks.description: Migrations for renewal_requests, renewal_events. Renewals Kanban for staff; customer flow from reminder or portal: confirm details → upload required documents → quote (official fee/premium + service fee) → approve & pay → processing → completed with new policy/certificate uploaded → new record saved → next due item scheduled. InsuranceProvider/DvlaProvider 'manual' adapters (tasks for staff). Insurance renewals gated by plan feature agent_renewals and garage having an insurance partner. Renewal invoices and commission income tracking. Pre-inspection repair job link for DVLA.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end insurance renewal completes and schedules next year's reminders
End-to-end DVLA roadworthy renewal completes
Garage without insurance partner cannot offer insurance renewal

tasks.title: Customer portal
tasks.description: Phone OTP login; link customer records across garages to the user; home with vehicle health cards; vehicle detail (history, documents, upcoming due items, mileage update); invoices & payments (pay balances and instalments); renewals; bookings; notification preferences and channel opt-outs; install PWA prompt and push opt-in.
acceptance_criteria: Customer sees only their own vehicles and only data from garages they have used
Customer can pay an outstanding instalment from the portal

phases.name: SaaS and polish
phases.goal: Ready to onboard garage #2 and charge for it.

tasks.title: Subscription billing and plan limits
tasks.description: Seed plans from plans.json. Paystack subscriptions (GHS, monthly), plan selection/upgrade/downgrade, trial, past_due handling (grace period then read-only), complimentary flag for pilot. Enforce max_staff and max_branches, feature gates, message allowance meter with 80%/100% alerts and add-on bundle purchase.
acceptance_criteria: Starter garage cannot invite a 6th staff member
past_due garage becomes read-only after grace period
Message meter matches message_log counts

tasks.title: Platform admin console
tasks.description: Garages list/detail, suspend, impersonate (banner + audit), vendor approvals, plans, DVLA fees, insurance partners, global templates and defaults, platform analytics (active garages, MRR, churn, message usage, renewals).
acceptance_criteria: Every impersonated action is audited with impersonated_by

tasks.title: Mechanic gamification and stats
tasks.description: Migrations for mechanic_stats. Streaks, jobs completed, hours, revenue, comebacks, badges (First Fix, Zero Comebacks Month, Speed Demon, 100 Jobs), optional weekly leaderboard, mechanic 'My stats' page with playful visuals.
acceptance_criteria: Badges awarded by nightly job
Leaderboard hidden when garage disables it

tasks.title: Fleet accounts
tasks.description: Fleet customers: multiple vehicles, fleet manager portal view of all vehicles, bulk approvals, consolidated credit statements, fleet reports.
acceptance_criteria: Fleet manager approves estimates for any fleet vehicle

tasks.title: Hardening and launch readiness
tasks.description: Run all acceptance-tests.json scenarios; Lighthouse and accessibility audits; rate limiting on public endpoints; security review of RLS and magic links; backups and restore drill; Sentry alerting; data export/delete request flow (Act 843); in-app help tips; marketing landing and pricing page.
acceptance_criteria: All acceptance tests pass on staging
Restore drill documented in docs/OPERATIONS.md
Lighthouse targets met

phases.name: Discovery and customer experience
phases.goal: Turn FixAm into a two-sided marketplace: garages get discovered, customers self-serve, and vehicle data drives matching.

tasks.title: Vehicle catalogue
tasks.description: Ghana-relevant vehicle_makes/vehicle_models tables seeded from curated catalogue, catalog FK columns on vehicles/portal_vehicles, picker UI in staff vehicle forms and portal vehicle registration, free-text fallback preserved.
acceptance_criteria: Staff and customers pick make/model from dropdowns backed by the catalogue
Custom makes/models still accepted as free text
Catalogue is readable by authenticated users; writes are service-role only

tasks.title: Customer self-registration
tasks.description: Portal profiles decoupled from staff customer records, customer vehicle claiming/creation from the portal, profile management, portal data isolation across garages.
acceptance_criteria: Customer registers via phone OTP and manages their own profile
Customer sees only their own vehicles and only garages they have visited
Claimed vehicles link to the matching customer record without duplicates

tasks.title: Garage geo + public directory
tasks.description: GPS coordinates captured at onboarding (browser locate + confirm), plan-gated directory_listing feature, public /garages search with name/city/service/make/model filters, near-me distance sort, public /garages/[slug] profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Only active garages on plans with directory_listing appear
Near-me sorts by haversine distance
Public profile shows services, coverage, branches and reviews without leaking private data

tasks.title: Service-matching search
tasks.description: garage_vehicle_coverage declares which makes/models a garage services (owner-managed in settings, catalogue or free text, audited); directory filters by vehicle; portal vehicle page lists other garages that service the car.
acceptance_criteria: Owner can add/remove coverage entries from settings
Directory make/model filter returns only garages covering that vehicle
Portal shows matching garages for a catalogued vehicle

tasks.title: Reviews & ratings
tasks.description: Portal customers rate garages they have visited (1-5 + comment, one review per garage per phone, upsert); ratings aggregate on directory cards and public profiles; owners moderate via hide/publish in settings.
acceptance_criteria: Only customers of a garage can review it
Resubmitting updates the existing review
Hidden reviews disappear from public aggregates but remain auditable

tasks.title: Vendor verification badge
tasks.description: Platform admin can verify approved vendors (verifiedAt/verifiedBy audited); verified badge on marketplace vendor groups, verified sellers sort first, badge on vendor dashboard and admin console.
acceptance_criteria: Verify requires approved status
Verified badge visible to garages browsing the marketplace
Verification and revocation are audit-logged

tasks.title: Landing page upgrade
tasks.description: Dual-audience marketing page: garage CTA funnel (onboarding/pricing) and customer CTA funnel (/garages directory, /portal), feature grids, how-it-works, footer nav.
acceptance_criteria: Both garage and customer paths have clear CTAs
Signed-in users still redirect via AuthGate

phases.name: Unified accounts and brokers
phases.goal: One account per person with role workspaces; insurance/DVLA brokers as a new workspace.

tasks.title: Unified accounts + phone sign-in
tasks.description: Single Supabase account for every role; FixAm SMS code mints a session (lib/auth/phone-auth.ts); workspaces + switcher (lib/accounts).
acceptance_criteria: Drivers, staff, vendors and brokers sign in on /login
One person can hold several workspaces and switch

tasks.title: Clean auth routes
tasks.description: /login, /signup, /signup/<role>, /onboarding, /onboarding/<role>, /account; proxy.ts + fixam_next cookie; no query strings.
acceptance_criteria: No ?next= or ?role= in any auth URL
Guests return to the page they wanted after sign-in

tasks.title: Brokers
tasks.description: brokers, broker_members, broker_requests, broker_request_events; /broker workspace; driver quotes at /portal/renewals; garage 'Send to broker'; admin verify/suspend.
acceptance_criteria: Request → quote → accept → complete with SMS at each step
Garages can still process renewals themselves

tasks.title: Ghana SMS adapters
tasks.description: Arkesel + Hubtel MessagingProvider; lib/messaging/direct.ts for platform SMS.
acceptance_criteria: MESSAGING_SMS_PROVIDER=arkesel|hubtel sends real SMS

phases.name: Smart repair marketplace, AI and on-road services
phases.goal: Complaint-first repairs with AI triage, instant part offers from vendors, customer parts delivered to garages with held payments, and trust-by-default features. Plus OBD diagnostics, photo part recognition, financing, breakdown/towing, pickup & drop-off, accident claims, a FixAm rider network, a garage WhatsApp AI assistant and pre-purchase inspections — all in scope now.

tasks.title: Parts taxonomy and fitment
tasks.description: part_types (≈150 seeded common parts with category, synonyms incl. Twi/Ga/Ewe/Hausa street names, typical labour hours); vendor_products gain part_type_id, condition (genuine|aftermarket|home_used), make/model/year-from/year-to fitment, oem_number, warranty_days; vendor catalogue UI + CSV import updated.
acceptance_criteria: Vendors list products against a part type with fitment and condition
Search 'brake pads Corolla 2014' returns only fitting products
Synonyms match (e.g. Twi street names) in search

tasks.title: theTeller payments, escrow ledger and payouts
tasks.description: PaymentProvider 'theteller' (checkout initiate, MoMo direct debit 000200, status check, card reversal); 12-digit numeric transaction ids; redirect_url handler + Inngest poller (no webhook); escrow_holds + payouts tables; vendor payouts via float transfer (MoMo 404000 / bank 404020 + authorize); commission + fitting fee in ledger; admin disputes & manual release/refund. Paystack stays behind the adapter until migrated.
acceptance_criteria: Customer pays by MoMo through theTeller test env and the hold shows 'held'
Pending transactions resolve via the poller without the redirect
Release triggers a vendor MoMo payout net of commission; failed payouts retry and alert admin
Every money movement is audit-logged and idempotent

tasks.title: Customer parts marketplace with delivery to garage
tasks.description: Portal 'Parts for my car' (compatible products only), cart, checkout destinations (my garage / any directory garage / home / pickup), vendor_orders gain buyer_user_id, destination_type, destination_garage_id, job_id, escrow_hold_id, rider fields; vendor assigns own rider or partner courier fallback (DeliveryProvider adapter, manual booking first); garage 'Incoming parts' list; receipt confirmation with photo releases the hold; 72 h auto-release; dispute flow.
acceptance_criteria: Customer buys a part delivered to their garage and the garage sees it on the job
Garage receipt photo releases funds to the vendor
Garages that refuse customer parts are not offered as destinations; fitting fee shown before payment

tasks.title: Diagnosis → instant part offers
tasks.description: Replace-type findings/estimate lines carry part_type_id (Claude maps free text with confidence; picker fallback); matcher returns own stock then vendor offers ranked by fit, price, ETA to garage, rating, distance; one-tap 'order to garage'; estimate approval page lets the customer choose 'garage supplies' vs 'I'll buy it' per line; garage settings accepts_customer_parts + customer_part_fitting_fee.
acceptance_criteria: Offers appear within 2 s of saving a replace finding
Customer choosing 'I'll buy it' creates a vendor order delivered to the garage, linked to the job
Garage markup applies only to garage-supplied lines

tasks.title: AI + speech providers
tasks.description: AiProvider (Claude API: structured JSON outputs, prompt registry, cost logging, PII minimisation) and SpeechProvider (Khaya AI ASR for tw, gaa, ee, ha, en_gh + translation; Claude fallback translation for pairs Khaya lacks), both with mocks and env selection.
acceptance_criteria: Mock providers used when keys are absent
Voice note in Twi/Ga/Ewe/Hausa returns transcript + English text
Each AI call logs model, tokens and cost per garage/user

tasks.title: Complaint-first repair requests + AI triage
tasks.description: repair_requests (+ media) and repair_request_offers; portal + public intake (text, voice, photos, video, warning light); AI triage JSON (causes, urgency, cost range, specialty, likely parts, follow-ups); send to preferred garage or broadcast by radius/specialty/make; garage Leads inbox with offers; accepting an offer books; check-in attaches the request to the job.
acceptance_criteria: Driver submits a voice complaint in Twi and sees triage in under 10 s
Broadcast reaches only matching garages within the radius
The job card shows the original complaint, media and triage

tasks.title: Old-part proof and before/after media
tasks.description: Replacement lines require old-part photo or 'customer took old part' before invoice issue (garage setting, default on); before/after photos and short video updates in /t tracker.
acceptance_criteria: Invoice issue blocked until proof exists when the setting is on
Customer sees before/after media on the tracker

tasks.title: Voice job notes → structured job card
tasks.description: Mechanic records voice in any of the 5 languages; AI drafts findings, tasks and parts for review; accepted items saved to the job.
acceptance_criteria: Mechanic reviews and edits the draft before saving
Nothing is saved without confirmation

tasks.title: Fair-quote check
tasks.description: price_observations from issued invoices (job type, part type, car class, city); quote comparison widget for customers and garages; hidden below 5 observations.
acceptance_criteria: Customer sees 'within typical range / above typical range' with sample size
No garage-identifying data exposed

tasks.title: Vehicle passport
tasks.description: Per-vehicle QR token, owner-controlled public history page /v/[token], printable sticker, share link on sale.
acceptance_criteria: Owner can enable/disable and regenerate the QR
Page shows service history without personal data

tasks.title: Seasonal reminders
tasks.description: reminder-rules: harmattan (filters) and rainy-season (wipers, tyres, brakes) campaigns per region.
acceptance_criteria: Campaigns respect opt-outs and quiet hours

tasks.title: Part recognition from photos
tasks.description: Customer or mechanic snaps a part; AiProvider vision returns part type, likely fitment, condition and confidence; result feeds the part-offers matcher and repair requests. Low confidence → pick from top 5.
acceptance_criteria: Photo of a common part returns the right part type ≥ 80% on the seeded test set
Offers for that part appear immediately

tasks.title: OBD-II scanner diagnostics
tasks.description: Web Bluetooth (Chrome on Android/desktop) to ELM327-compatible BLE dongles: read VIN, fault codes (stored/pending/permanent), freeze frame and live data (RPM, coolant, speed, voltage); clear codes (staff only, audited). DTC library + AI plain-language explanation with likely parts. Scans attach to repair requests, jobs and inspections. iOS: show 'use Android/Chrome' until a native app exists.
acceptance_criteria: Mechanic pairs a dongle and reads codes on Android Chrome
Each code shows meaning, severity and likely parts with vendor offers
Clearing codes requires staff role and writes an audit row

tasks.title: Fix now, pay later
tasks.description: FinancingProvider adapter (partner lender, mock first). At estimate approval/invoice the customer can apply to pay over 1–6 months; partner decides; garage is paid up-front by the partner; repayments tracked and reminded. Existing garage-run instalments remain as an option.
acceptance_criteria: Customer applies from the approval page and gets a decision
Approved financing marks the invoice paid for the garage
Repayment reminders follow messaging quiet hours

tasks.title: Breakdown & towing (SOS)
tasks.description: New workspace/role: tow operators (/signup/tow-operator, /tow). Driver SOS button: GPS, problem type, photos → nearest available tow operators and garages notified; first to accept is assigned; live location sharing, ETA, price quote, Teller payment; destination = chosen garage (creates a booking/repair request).
acceptance_criteria: SOS reaches tow operators within the radius in < 10 s
Driver sees the assigned operator, ETA and price
Tow completion creates a repair request at the destination garage

tasks.title: Car pickup & drop-off
tasks.description: Garages offer pickup/drop-off with a fee and service area; booking option; staff role 'driver' (garage driver) gets pickup jobs; handover condition report (photos all sides, fuel, mileage, warning lights, customer signature) at pickup and return; live status on the tracker.
acceptance_criteria: Customer books pickup with a booking
Driver completes a photo condition report at pickup and drop-off
Customer sees both reports and live status

tasks.title: Accident & insurance claims
tasks.description: Claim wizard for drivers: accident photos, location/time, police report number + upload, other party details, injuries yes/no, preferred garage. Garage adds a repair estimate. Documents and timeline shared between driver, garage and broker.

Broker sees and updates the claim; driver and garage are notified
Approved claims authorise the linked garage job

tasks.description: New workspace/role: riders (/signup/rider, /rider). tasks.title: Garage WhatsApp AI assistant
tasks.description: WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) number per garage or shared FixAm number with garage routing. Human handoff + garage inbox; every outbound uses approved templates outside the 24 h window.

Staff can take over any conversation

tasks.title: Pre-purchase inspections
tasks.description: Driver books an inspection for a car they plan to buy (seller location or garage); inspector (garage staff) runs a ~120-point checklist with photos, OBD scan, test drive notes, body/paint and flood/accident signs; AI summary + estimated repair costs; PDF report + share link; price paid via theTeller.
